profile_text.body:
Khan Academy is a nonprofit educational organization whose website describes its mission as providing free, world-class education. The site's content harvested for this profile was limited, returning only a challenge response rather than substantive copy, so detail drawn directly from the site is thin.

The organization's tracked AI product is Khanmigo, categorized as an educational AI tutor. The held facts note that Khanmigo involves student interaction data, is subject to COPPA compliance considerations, and raises questions of pedagogical bias in its design and deployment.

No litigation, SEC filings, MCP servers, or patent records are associated with Khan Academy in the held facts. The organization is confirmed as a nonprofit and its profile was verified on 2026-08-28.
